Callout.Name: Damage to a Trail
Callout.Advisory: Deep tyre marks, no vehicles present.

Script.Line: They have torn the trail up for half a mile.
It is protected ground and they came in the night to do it.
Four sets of tracks. Big tyres, all four of them.

Lines.Approach: Somebody has cut the trail up and left. The rangers will want to see it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
